CLI Reference

bp

BenchPRO-NG: HPC Benchmark Orchestrator

bp [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

build-cli

Manage application builds

bp build-cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

list

List registered builds

bp build-cli list [OPTIONS]

run

Build an application from a config file

bp build-cli run [OPTIONS] CONFIG_FILE

Options

--dry-run

Simulate build

Arguments

CONFIG_FILE

Required argument

completion-cli

Manage shell completion

bp completion-cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

install

Install shell completion

bp completion-cli install [OPTIONS]

Options

--shell <shell>

Shell to install completion for

Options:

bash | zsh | fish

config-cli

Manage configuration

bp config-cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

show

Show current configuration

bp config-cli show [OPTIONS]

Options

--resolved

Show fully resolved config

results-cli

Manage results

bp results-cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

list

List recent runs

bp results-cli list [OPTIONS]

Options

-l, --limit <limit>

Limit number of runs

show

Show details for a specific run

bp results-cli show [OPTIONS] RUN_ID

Arguments

RUN_ID

Required argument

suite-cli

Manage benchmark suites

bp suite-cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

plan

Plan a suite execution

bp suite-cli plan [OPTIONS] SUITE_FILE

Options

-N, --nodes <nodes>

Override nodes

-n, --ranks-per-node <ranks_per_node>

Override ranks per node

-c, --threads <threads>

Override threads per rank

-g, --gpus <gpus>

Override GPUs per node

--json

Output plan as JSON

Arguments

SUITE_FILE

Required argument

run

Run a benchmark suite

bp suite-cli run [OPTIONS] SUITE_FILE

Options

--dry-run

Simulate execution

Arguments

SUITE_FILE

Required argument

task-cli

Manage individual tasks

bp task-cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

run

Run a single task immediately

bp task-cli run [OPTIONS] COMMAND

Options

--nodes <nodes>

Number of nodes

--ranks <ranks>

Ranks per node

--threads <threads>

Threads per rank

--gpus <gpus>

GPUs per node

--build-code <build_code>

Application code to bind

--build-version <build_version>

Application version to bind

--build-label <build_label>

Build label to bind

--dry-run

Simulate execution

Arguments

COMMAND

Required argument

version

Show version info

bp version [OPTIONS]
